items.title: Alibaba Bans Claude Code Internally Due to Backdoor Risk, Recommends Qoder Instead
items.title_zh: 因存在植入后门风险，阿里内部全面禁用Claude Code，推荐Qoder替代
items.summary: Alibaba has classified Claude Code as high-risk software after reports of backdoor vulnerabilities and will ban internal use effective July 10, recommending Qoder as the replacement. The internal assessment concluded the security risk warranted immediate action across all office environments.

items.title: Samsung Reportedly Wins Over 10 Trillion Won Meta AI Chip Foundry Order
items.title_zh: 三星传获Meta超10万亿韩元AI芯片代工订单
items.summary: Samsung Electronics has reportedly secured a foundry order from Meta worth over 10 trillion won for AI chip manufacturing. Samsung's 4nm process is now nearly sold out with some 8nm lines close to full capacity, prompting the company to implement quota-based allocation for new customers.

items.title: Embodied AI Robots Begin Entering Chinese Homes — 74 Yuan for 3 Hours of Household Chores
items.title_zh: 具身智能机器人开始进入中国家庭：74元可请3小时家务服务
items.summary: China's embodied AI robots are now available for hire in homes for as low as 74 yuan for 3 hours of household chores, sparking debate about the real-world value delivered by multi-billion-dollar embodied AI investments. The service marks a shift from lab demonstrations to consumer-facing deployments.

items.title: Microsoft Forms 6,000-Person AI Deployment Company with $2.5 Billion Commitment
items.title_zh: 微软砸25亿美元组建6000人AI新公司
items.summary: Microsoft has launched a new AI deployment group with 6,000 employees and a $2.5 billion commitment, following similar moves by Amazon, OpenAI, and Anthropic to build dedicated enterprise AI deployment infrastructure. The scale of the investment underscores the intensifying cloud AI arms race.

items.title: Nobel-Winning Materials Scientist Omar Yaghi Leaves US for Tsinghua University AI Research Center
items.title_zh: 诺贝尔化学奖得主Omar Yaghi离开美国加入清华大学AI研究中心
items.summary: Omar Yaghi, the 2025 Nobel Prize winner for chemistry, has left the US to lead a new AI-driven materials research center at Tsinghua University. The 61-year-old scientist will focus on using AI to transform the design and synthesis of new materials, aiming to shorten development cycles 'by orders of magnitude.'

items.title: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen Simultaneously Announce Removal of AI Agent Features
items.title_zh: 字节跳动豆包与阿里通义千问同日宣布下线AI Agent功能
items.summary: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen (Qwen) simultaneously announced the removal of AI agent features effective July 15. The coordinated sunsetting of agent capabilities by two major Chinese AI platforms raises questions about regulatory pressure or safety concerns.

items.title: New Serious Vulnerabilities Spike Around Release of Claude Mythos Preview
items.title_zh: Claude Mythos Preview发布前后严重漏洞数量激增
items.summary: Data from Epoch AI shows a notable spike in serious vulnerabilities coinciding with the release of Claude Mythos Preview, with a sharp increase in CVE severity reports. The correlation has drawn attention from the security community regarding AI model release safety practices.

items.title: Chinese Scientists' Brain-Mimicking Chip 'Up to 478 Times Faster Than Nvidia A100 GPU'
items.title_zh: 中国科学家脑拟态芯片号称比Nvidia A100快478倍
items.summary: Chinese scientists have developed a brain-mimicking computer chip capable of modeling complex brain structures in real time, reportedly achieving speeds up to 478 times faster than Nvidia A100 GPU for specific neuromorphic workloads. The chip could potentially transform diagnostics and treatment for conditions such as Alzheimer's disease.

items.title: Claude Code Session/Cache Leakage Between Workspace Instances or Consumer Accounts Reported
items.title_zh: Claude Code被报告存在工作区实例间会话/缓存泄漏问题
items.summary: A GitHub issue reports potential session and cache leakage between Claude Code workspace instances or consumer accounts, raising data isolation concerns. The report on Hacker News garnered significant attention with over 120 points and 46 comments.

items.title: The Fanfiction Community Is at War with AI — and Itself
items.title_zh: 同人小说社区与AI及自身陷入战争
items.summary: A new fanworks movement aims to root out authors using generative AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, but the detection methods being implemented are questionable. Any fanfic writer could be caught in the crossfire as the community struggles with AI authorship boundaries.

items.title: Tesla Q2 Deliveries Surge 25% to 480K, Crushing Wall Street Estimates
items.title_zh: 特斯拉Q2交付量飙升25%达48万辆，远超华尔街预期
items.summary: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026, a 25% year-over-year increase that crushed Wall Street estimates of approximately 400,000-408,000 units. Production reached 451,758 with Model 3 and Model Y accounting for the vast majority, suggesting Tesla has cleared significant inventory.

items.title: Texas Man Charged in Fatal Tesla Crash — Tesla Data Shows He Overrode Autopilot
items.title_zh: 得州特斯拉致命车祸司机被控过失杀人，特斯拉数据表明其接管了自动驾驶
items.summary: Michael Butler has been charged with manslaughter after his Tesla crashed into a Texas home killing a woman. While Butler claimed the vehicle was in self-driving mode, Tesla data reportedly shows he overrode the Autopilot system, shifting the focus from FSD reliability to driver responsibility.

items.title: Matic's Robot Vacuum Getting a $250 Price Hike in September
items.title_zh: Matic扫地机器人9月起涨价250美元
items.summary: Matic will raise the price of its robot vacuum by $250 on September 9, increasing from $1,245 to $1,495. The Verge considers the Matic the best robot vacuum available, and the price change may reflect increased component costs amid the semiconductor shortage.

sections.label: China Tech News / 中国科技新闻

items.title: 外骨骼机器人走向户外：傲鲨VIATRIX让徒步变成科幻现实
items.title_zh: 外骨骼机器人走向户外：傲鲨VIATRIX让徒步变成科幻现实
items.summary: 傲鲨在阳澄湖举办外骨骼机甲徒步活动，参与者身穿VIATRIX增程动力外骨骼机器人完成6公里湖岸徒步。该外骨骼通过学习行走姿态在抬腿瞬间提供推力，将徒步体验转变为悠闲漫步。外骨骼机器人正从工厂和康复科走向户外运动场景。

items.title: 具身智能公司光象科技累计完成数亿元天使轮融资
items.title_zh: 具身智能公司光象科技累计完成数亿元天使轮融资
items.summary: 光象科技宣布完成累计数亿元天使轮融资，投资方包括珠海科技产业集团、兴证资本、松禾资本等头部机构。资金将重点投入物理原生基座模型的研发迭代，并推进具身智能机器人产品的商业化交付。

items.title: 中国人形机器人百人会联合发布倡议：规范引导情感陪伴人形机器人健康发展
items.title_zh: 中国人形机器人百人会联合发布倡议：规范引导情感陪伴人形机器人健康发展
items.organization: 中国人形机器人百人会 / 中国机械工业联合会
items.summary: 中国人形机器人百人会和中国机械工业联合会联合发布倡议，要求将安全伦理规范融入情感陪伴人形机器人的设计、研发、广告宣传全过程，加强个人信息保护、质量管理，防范人身伤害风险。当前人形机器人正加速进入家庭场景。

items.title: 36氪首发｜剑桥副教授创业硅光芯片，已合作欧莱雅、华为，获一亿投资
items.title_zh: 36氪首发｜剑桥副教授创业硅光芯片，已合作欧莱雅、华为，获一亿投资
items.summary: 硅基光电子集成芯片研发商光引科技完成1亿元Pre-A轮融资，投资方包括光子强链基金、善达投资等。创始人程祺翔为剑桥大学博士、副教授，曾在华为海思光电团队任职。公司已与华为、欧莱雅建立合作关系，产品聚焦微型光谱仪芯片。

items.title: 业内首个AI-eSIM产业协同平台成立，中国移动牵头40余家企业参与
items.title_zh: 业内首个AI-eSIM产业协同平台成立，中国移动牵头40余家企业参与
items.summary: 中国移动发起的业内首个AI-eSIM产业协同平台正式成立，汇聚运营商、芯片设计、算法研究、安全服务及模型应用等领域的40余家头部企业。天翼物联、联通华盛、火山引擎、腾讯云、观安信息等担任副主任单位。

items.title: Semiconductor Prices Skyrocket as AI Demand Fuels Industry-Wide Chip Shortage
items.title_zh: AI需求推动半导体全行业短缺，芯片价格飙升
items.summary: Over 20 chip manufacturers have announced their second price hikes in 2026, with AI-specific MLCC components surging 3-10x and delivery lead times extending to mid-2027. The shortage is driven by AI infrastructure demand outpacing semiconductor fabrication capacity.

items.title: Alibaba DAMO Academy's ElementsClaw AI Discovers 4 New Superconductors in Just 28 GPU Hours
items.title_zh: 阿里达摩院ElementsClaw AI在28 GPU小时内发现4种新超导体
items.summary: Alibaba DAMO Academy's AI agent ElementsClaw discovered 4 previously unknown superconductors by screening 2.4 million crystal structures in just 28 GPU hours. The achievement demonstrates the accelerating impact of AI-driven materials discovery.

items.title: 74 Yuan for 3 Hours: Embodied AI Robots Begin Entering Chinese Homes for Household Chores
items.title_zh: 具身智能机器人开始进入中国家庭：74元可请3小时家务服务
items.summary: China's embodied AI robots are now available for hire in homes for as low as 74 yuan for 3 hours of household chores, sparking debate about the real-world value delivered by multi-billion-dollar embodied AI investments. The service marks a shift from lab demonstrations to consumer-facing deployments.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks — Extracted System Prompts from Major LLMs
items.title_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks — 主流LLM系统提示词合集
items.summary: A repository collecting extracted system prompts from Anthropic Claude (Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code), OpenAI (ChatGPT 5.5, GPT 5.5 Instant, Codex), Google (Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro), xAI Grok, Cursor, Copilot, and others. Updated regularly.

items.title: mattpocock/skills — Claude Code Skills for Real Engineers
items.title_zh: mattpocock/skills — 面向工程师的Claude Code技能合集
items.summary: A curated collection of Claude Code skills from a prominent TypeScript educator, sharing his personal .claude directory with production-oriented engineering skills and workflows.

items.title: alirezarezvani/claude-skills — 337 Claude Code Skills Across 10+ Coding Agents
items.title_zh: alirezarezvani/claude-skills — 337个Claude Code技能支持10+编码代理
items.summary: A massive collection of 337 Claude Code skills covering engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, and finance, with support for 10+ coding agents including Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — Compact 0.6B Conversational Model with 28M+ Downloads
items.title_zh: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — 下载量超2800万的紧凑型对话模型
items.summary: Qwen3-0.6B, the smallest model in Alibaba's Qwen3 family, has accumulated over 28 million downloads with strong community adoption for edge deployment and lightweight conversational applications.

items.title: BAAI/bge-m3 — Multilingual Embedding Model with 32M+ Downloads
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 下载量超3200万的多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BAAI's bge-m3 multilingual embedding model continues to dominate with over 32 million downloads, offering strong cross-lingual retrieval performance and serving as a foundational component in RAG pipelines worldwide.

items.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
items.title_zh: Embodied.cpp：面向异构机器人的具身AI模型可移植推理运行时
items.summary: Researchers present Embodied.cpp, a portable inference runtime enabling embodied AI models (VLA and world-action models) to run across heterogeneous robot platforms without model-specific Python stacks or robot-side glue code, addressing a key deployment fragmentation problem.

items.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic Pretraining for VLAs
items.title_zh: 先学移动再学做：视觉-语言-动作模型的无任务预训练
items.summary: Addressing the scarcity of expert demonstration data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this paper proposes task-agnostic pretraining focused on learning movement primitives before task-specific skills, reducing the data bottleneck in robot learning.
